purpose: Represent a fail-closed risk decision between confirmation and final trade decision.
invariants: Risk Gate is downstream of confirmation.
Risk approval does not mean execution.
UNKNOWN risk evidence cannot produce approval.
No future outcome is an input.
No historical Winner/Survivor data is an input.
No leverage, position-size, stop-distance, drawdown, or RR threshold is embedded in this contract.
Every risk check must be traceable to contemporaneous evidence.
The gate fails closed when no versioned risk policy is supplied.
